Quarterly maintenance review generated by the scheduled workflow.

- [ ] Reconcile direct/transitive dependency advisories, licenses, provenance,
      stale packages, and the frozen lockfile.
- [ ] Review pinned Actions, Node, pnpm, TypeScript, test, lint, package-audit,
      and trusted-publishing toolchains.
- [ ] Confirm required/advisory Node lines and upstream EOL dates; open or
      update the migration issue when a trigger is reached.
- [ ] Review open regressions, severity/ownership, deprecations, security
      backport obligations, failed publishes, and release candidates.
- [ ] Run the patch and security-patch maintenance tabletops.
- [ ] Confirm support table, issue forms/labels, security policy, migrations,
      and release documentation still match repository and registry reality.
- [ ] Record accepted risks, owners, target releases, and follow-up links before
      closing this issue.

Policy: https://github.com/W0rldHacker/kasane/blob/main/docs/maintenance.md
